description.value: The KPU Brew Lab is the teaching brewery of Kwantlen Polytechnic University's Brewing and Brewery Operations diploma program, open to the public for sales of student-brewed craft beers in 6-packs, growler fills, and kegs. The program has earned multiple accolades including Brewery of the Year at the 2019 BC Beer Awards and recognition as one of the top three brewing schools in North America at the 2024 US Open College Beer Championship. The rotating tap list changes weekly and spans styles from Belgian witbier to West Coast IPA, with limited-edition Student Signature Series releases each year.
